hypothesis: Frozen V5 improves RS10 against a Vanna-based control given the same backbone, knowledge pool and generation-cap envelope on new eligible inputs.
replicate_note: Fresh independent API calls in separate caches. Temperature 0 does not guarantee determinism. Repeated queries do not increase the number of independent questions.
execution_repair: At most one schema/execution-error repair per route for each family; never semantic rewriting after scoring.
budget_comparison: Same route count, thinking settings, output caps and repair allowance for the three generation families; actual input/output tokens and cost can differ and must be reported. This is NOT exact dollar/token matching.

arms.vanna_native_single: Native Vanna prompt/extraction, direct route, before optional repair; practical reference only, not compute matched.
arms.vanna_matched_three: Vanna retrieval/native prompt/extraction; three route envelopes plus common GEF and strict-three round3 full-row execution agreement. This is an augmented Vanna control, not off-the-shelf Vanna.
arms.dense_three_v5: Same V3 prompts, metadata access and V5 postprocessing, replace only structured example reranker with dense top-4 examples plus top-2 null examples from the same pool.
arms.ours_direct_gef: Direct route of unchanged structured generation and original V3 guard; one-candidate reference.
arms.ours_raw_three: Same unchanged three candidates, strict-three V3 raw fingerprint; no V4/V5 normalization.
arms.ours_round3_no_compiler: Same candidates with unchanged V4 normalization, strict-three round3; disable V5 namespace compiler.
arms.v5_full: Unchanged V3 generation and frozen V5 strict3_canonical. No refitting.

statistics.unit: question cluster averaged across all three replicates
statistics.cluster_id: Externally supplied, reviewed template/family ID for every question; never infer independence from unique question IDs.
statistics.confidence_interval: Paired cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261029, percentile 95% interval of mean RS10 difference.
statistics.test: Paired cluster sign-flip randomization, 10000 samples, two-sided, seed 20261029; clustered sums with fixed question denominator.
statistics.secondary_multiple_testing: Holm adjustment across the four predeclared secondary contrasts.
statistics.confirmation_rule: All expected questions and three replicates complete; valid provenance; primary mean delta > 0, 95% lower CI > 0, randomization p < 0.05. Otherwise report inconclusive/negative, do not select another metric, subset or policy.
statistics.limitations: Model pretraining exposure cannot be ruled out. Template clusters do not guarantee patient independence. No causal claim versus the original fine-tuned ProbGate model.

dataset_eligibility.numeric_literal_mask_rule: Identical normalized questions after masking standalone numeric literals are also rejected; changing patient IDs/dates alone is not new independent evidence.
dataset_eligibility.near_duplicate_rule: Token-set Jaccard >= 0.85 against old train/dev/test questions blocks confirmation pending a documented new protocol/review; threshold fixed before dataset inspection.
dataset_eligibility.minimum_cluster_note: Operational guard only; not a power guarantee. Report uncertainty and do not promise superiority based on sample size alone.

old_test_policy: Only no-API, cached-output exploratory ablations; never tune or rename the old test as independent confirmation.

paper_reference.role: Historical reference on original 1167 questions only. Never compare its numeric score directly against a score on another dataset.

stop_rule: Do not stop when score exceeds a target. Finish all predeclared arms and replicates, or retain incomplete state after provider/infrastructure failure. No null padding.
